lines.zh: 我一步一步走，尾巴拖在地上。
lines.en: I walk step by step, tail dragging.
I walk along the desert's edge.
I tread the badlands' red clay.

lines.zh: 我朝那股火焰的味道走。
lines.en: I walk toward that smell of fire.
I come out from behind the rocks.

lines.zh: 我的爪子刮着地，留下痕。
lines.en: My claws rake the ground, leaving marks.

lines.zh: 我走过下界的荒地，很自在。
lines.en: I cross the Nether wastes; I'm at ease.
I come slowly toward you.
I stop and turn my head at you.
I keep low, as if stalking.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方空气变热。
lines.en: The air warms where I pass.
I walk the volcanic rock; it doesn't burn.

lines.zh: 我趴着，火从嘴里漏出来。
lines.en: I lie there, fire leaking from my mouth.
I'm licking my claws.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一下一下敲地。
lines.en: My tail taps the ground.
I'm counting the heat sources.
Fire rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 我伏在热石上，让鳞片回温。
lines.en: I lie on the hot stone, warming my scales.
I circle near my anchor.

lines.zh: 我打了个呵欠，喷出火星。
lines.en: I yawn, spitting sparks.
My scales are dark red.

lines.zh: 我在等，等一个能烧的东西。
lines.en: I wait for something worth burning.
I lift a forepaw and look at it.

lines.zh: 我记得还没进化的时候。
lines.en: I remember before I evolved.
I lower my head to rest.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有打斗的声音。
lines.en: I hear a fight far off.

lines.zh: 你身上有将要燃烧的味道。
lines.en: You smell like something about to burn.

lines.zh: 我看你膝盖微弯，随时要跑。
lines.en: I see your knees bent, ready to run.
My mouth is shut, but the fire's inside.

lines.zh: 我看你露在甲外的部分，全是软的。
lines.en: Everything I see outside your armor is soft.
I tilt my head, sizing you up.
That weapon of yours will melt.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟往后挪，我看见了。
lines.en: Your heel slid back; I saw it.
I can smell your sweat.
I lift a foot and step forward.
Don't stand in my line of fire.

lines.zh: 我侧过头，一只眼对着你。
lines.en: I turn my head and fix one eye on you.
The iron you carry smells like it'll melt.
I open my mouth and show my teeth.
You're my first today.

lines.zh: 你站的位置很空，容易烧。
lines.en: You're standing in the open; easy to burn.
I wait for your next move.
A hard scale came off my back.
I step back, my throat dimming.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我肩上，很沉。
lines.en: That hit my shoulder, heavy.

lines.zh: 鳞缝里渗出黑烟，我甩了甩。
lines.en: Black smoke seeps from my scale seams; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出一声，很沉。
lines.en: A sound rolls out of my throat, low and heavy.
I slowly straighten up.
I lick the split.
The blood dries on me quickly.
I retreat to the hot stone's edge.
I can still burn.
That fire would burn well.
Will what you hold burn?
I take one step your way.
Warm things draw me in.
Leave the torch and I'll let you go.
The fire in my throat stirs.
I smell coal.

lines.zh: 那团火再靠近些，我看看。
lines.en: Bring that flame closer; let me look.
I come closer; I won't bite.
Those sparks are tempting.
Toss that flame over here.
I smell something burnt.
You hit my back and can't move it.
I step back, scorching the ground.
My scales scrape your armor.
I turn and shoulder you aside.

lines.zh: 你踩了我的尾巴，我一甩。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail; I flick it free.
We collide, and sparks fly.

lines.zh: 你推我一下，自己退了半步。
lines.en: You shove me once and give up half a step.

lines.zh: 我退到岩石后，慢慢蹲下。
lines.en: I back behind the rock and crouch.
My tail scrapes your knee.
You step back; then I rise.
Another lies by the fire too.
Her scales are darker than mine.
We lie side by side on the hot stone.

lines.zh: 她的尾巴绕到我的腰上。
lines.en: Her tail winds around my flank.
We breathe small jets of fire together.
Her horns are shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着这块热地。
lines.en: We keep this warm ground together.
She burns a thorn off my back.

lines.zh: 我们不需要说话，都懂热。
lines.en: We needn't speak; we both know heat.
Two dark-red shapes, leaning together.
I pick up coal and crush it.

lines.zh: 我把你的盾咬了个牙印。
lines.en: I leave teeth marks in your shield.
I pick up that raw meat and swallow it.
I hold a fireball in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把地上的骨头烧成灰。
lines.en: I burn the bones on the ground to ash.
I carry off the fish you dropped.

lines.zh: 我拖着一截树干，烧断了。
lines.en: I drag a log and burn it through.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块黑石，扔远了。
lines.en: I pick up blackstone and throw it far.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的披风，烧了个洞。
lines.en: I bite your cloak and burn a hole.
I gather the sparks into my mouth.
You've stepped onto my hot ground.

lines.zh: 你带着外面的凉气，我闻到了。
lines.en: You carry cold air from outside; I smell it.
I raise my head, my throat glowing.
I pick up my pace.

lines.zh: 你那身皮甲，我一碰火就卷。
lines.en: That leather of yours curls at my first flame.
This range is enough to breathe.
I've chosen you; don't run.
My claws dig into the sand.
My tail snaps upright.
You're between me and the cliff.

lines.zh: 我把重心前移，后脚刨着沙。
lines.en: I shift my weight forward, hind claws scraping sand.
This time I won't use fire.

lines.zh: 我踩着你的脚印，保持这个距离。
lines.en: I step in your footprints, keeping this distance.
You go left; I circle left.

lines.zh: 我的指甲刮过石头，声音很尖。
lines.en: My claws rake the stone with a sharp sound.
My throat stays lit.
Raise the shield; it won't help.
I breathe once, as a warning.
You can't run fast in sand.
I slip along the cliff past you.

lines.zh: 我的鼻息喷在你后颈上。
lines.en: My breath hits the back of your neck.
I draw the fire back.

lines.zh: 我等你离岩壁再远一点。
lines.en: I wait for you to leave the cliff side.
I lunge once and miss.
I slam a claw down, cracking the ground.

lines.zh: 牙卡进甲缝，我往旁边撕。
lines.en: My teeth catch the seam and I tear sideways.

lines.zh: Mega Flame 从嘴里冲出去。
lines.en: Mega Flame rushes out of my mouth.

lines.zh: 我尾巴贴地扫过去，你站不稳。
lines.en: My tail sweeps low; your footing goes.

lines.zh: 我低头顶上去，角尖挑你的腹。
lines.en: I lower my head and gore your midsection.

lines.zh: 我爪子落下时，火星溅到你脸上。
lines.en: As my claw lands, sparks splash your face.
I pounce and pin you.
It retreats; the fire still burns.
I open my mouth: bite first, then flame.

lines.zh: 我爪子被你架开，火从侧面来。
lines.en: You parry my claws; the fire comes from the side.
I catch your wrist; it's hot.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，牙陷进护肩。
lines.en: I bite down; my teeth sink into your pauldron.

lines.zh: 沙漠的热气里，我站起来。
lines.en: In the desert's heat, I rise.

lines.zh: 我从恶地的裂缝里爬出来。
lines.en: I climb out of a badlands crack.
Plenty of fire-smell here.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，沙从鳞上滑下。
lines.en: I shake, and sand slides off my scales.
My throat lights for the first time.

lines.zh: 黑森林里太潮了，我不喜欢。
lines.en: The dark forest is too damp; I dislike it.
I scent something alive far off.
I tread the hot stone; it feels right.
I look up and see smoke.

lines.zh: 我慢慢展开身体站起来。
lines.en: I slowly unfold and rise.
This ground has an owner now.
I hear someone break a stone.
Fire lands on me like a bath.

lines.zh: 落地时我侧身一滚，压碎了几块石头。
lines.en: I hit and roll sideways, crushing a few stones.
Water hits me and I steam.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，鳞都翻了。
lines.en: The blast flips me, scales askew.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我背上，立刻焦了。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back and chars at once.
A light presses my fire down.
Hunger dims my throat.

lines.zh: 雷打在我头上，牙都在响。
lines.en: Lightning hits my head; my teeth rattle.

lines.zh: 这里没有热，我很不舒服。
lines.en: There's no heat here; I'm miserable.
